name: Mother
source:
She refuses to accept the brutal death of her son and continues to care for him as if he were still alive, locking herself into a macabre illusion.

In the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony, Mother is a patient at Clark County Psych Ward. [Spoiler]She is currently separated from Father and oblivious to Agatha's efforts to seduce her husband. Once Agatha is successfully rejected by all male suitors, Mother offers herself as a romantic option.

Her real name, Ruth, is only revealed in this game.[/Spoiler]
